proposals.title: test(vn-holidays): add tests/holidays.test.ts with edge cases beyond the golden fixtures
proposals.body:
## Problem
`vn-holidays` has only `tests/holidays-golden.test.ts` (4 `it` blocks that iterate `tests/golden/vn-holidays.json`). Every other skill has a dedicated `tests/<name>.test.ts`, and CONTRIBUTING requires one. Behaviour that is not a pure input->output case is untested: error results for malformed dates, `announced: false` for years without data, `addWorkingDays` with n=0 or a negative n, and ranges that cross a year boundary.

## Acceptance
- [ ] New `tests/holidays.test.ts` with >= 20 cases covering: invalid date input (`ok: false` with code and hint), a year with no announcement (`announced: false`, statutory days only), weekend-collision compensation, `addWorkingDays` with n = 0 and with a negative n, and a year-boundary crossing
- [ ] Only assert behaviour the current implementation already has. If a case exposes a bug, report it in the PR instead of silently changing behaviour
- [ ] Do not edit `packages/core/data/*.json`
- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm format:check` pass
proposals.rationale: The holidays skill has no dedicated test file, unlike the other skills, and CONTRIBUTING requires >= 20 tests per skill.

proposals.title: vn-pit: personal income tax calculator (needs a legal source first)
proposals.body:
## Problem
ROADMAP RM-015 is still `idea`. A PIT calculator needs the current brackets, personal and dependant deduction amounts, insurance rates and effective dates. None of these are in the repository.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The maintainer cites the legal source and effective dates in this issue
- [ ] Then: core function + CLI command + MCP tool + `skills/vn-pit/SKILL.md` with Vietnamese trigger words + >= 20 tests in `tests/vn-pit.test.ts` + an entry in `tests/skills.test.ts`
- [ ] Rates live in a data file with a source URL, not in code
proposals.rationale: [needs a person] RM-015 has no open issue. It cannot be implemented without a legal source that only the maintainer can supply.

kv.value: The repo is consistent on MCP tool names and the README tool lists, and the open issue list is empty. The weak spot I saw is thin dedicated test coverage for vn-holidays. The remaining roadmap items need a human (legal sources, credentials, samples, or recordings).
